'''''Echium rosulatum''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Boraginaceae]]. It is endemic to the western portion of the [[Iberian Peninsula]] in Portugal, [[Galicia (Spain)]] and the [[Sierra Morena]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Echium rosulatum Lange |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/6DX9H |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=24 July 2022}}</ref> It favors acidic and somewhat nitrified soil. It has two subspecies, one native to mainland Iberia and the other one (subsp. ''davaei'') native to the [[Berlengas|Berlengas archipelago]].<ref name="iberica" />

==Description==
''Echium rosulatum'' is a perennial and generally multi-stemmed plant with [[decumbent]] or [[ascending (botany)|ascending]] stems. Leaves are partly to fully [[sericeous]] with scant [[indumentum]], few [[seta|setae]] and short hairs. The basal leaves are [[Glossary of leaf morphology#elliptic|elliptic]] or [[Glossary of leaf morphology#oblanceolate|oblanceolate]], they form a [[Rosette (botany)|rosette]] and have a slightly marked petiole. The stem leaves range from [[Glossary of leaf morphology#oblong|oblong]] or elliptic in the middle, to narrowly [[Glossary of leaf morphology#ovate|ovate]] or ovate-lanceolate in the upper portion.<ref name="iberica" />

===Inflorescence===
The inflorescence is [[panicle|panicled]], loose, with [[Inflorescence#Determinate or cymose|cymes]] around 13 cm (up to 18 cm (5.1 to 7.1 in)) when fruiting. Flowers are [[zygomorphic]]. The [[bract]]s are ovate-lanceolate and are longer than the [[sepal|calyx]]. The [[funnel]]-shaped [[petal|corolla]] is {{convert|15|-|25|mm|abbr=on}} long (up to 30 mm) and is covered in small hairs in almost all its surface, with some longer hairs on the nerves. Three to four [[stamen]]s (two in certain cases) are exerted from the corolla. The stamens' filaments are whitish and sparsely hairy. At least two of the ovoid, bluish-brown anthers are exerted. The [[Stigma (botany)#Style|style]] is hairy and longer than the corolla.<ref name="iberica">{{cite web |title=Echium rosulatum |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/11_138_16_Echium.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=24 July 2022}}</ref>
